answer: Because the trellis graph is rebuilt each epoch, the voyage merge is applied at settlement and the vine audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 50 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
